core_meaning.primary_meaning: Ilmi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Of knowledge; scholarly, scientific”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Ilmi corresponds to the Arabic form علمي (Arabic root ع ل م (ʿ-l-m); عِلْمِيّ (ʿIlmiyy)). Its core sense is of knowledge; scholarly, scientific. Ilmi is Arabic عِلْمِيّ (ʿIlmiyy) 'of knowledge; scholarly, scientific', from the root ع ل م (ʿ-l-m). The source gloss 'Knowledge' is broadly consistent. Recorded at medium confidence because the word is primarily an adjective.

faq.q: What is the origin of Ilmi?
faq.a: Ilmi originates in Arabic and circulates in Muslim naming communities.
Yes, the recorded form علمي is Arabic.

faq.q: What is the root of Ilmi?
faq.a: It is built on the root ع ل م (ʿ-l-m).
Ilmi is used by Muslims, but it is a lexical name rather than an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Ilmi is not independently established as a Qur'anic personal name.

faq.q: What does Ilmi mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu it is written علمی and carries the sense “علمی، علمیاتی، دانشورانہ”.

faq.q: Is Ilmi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records Ilmi as a boy's name; actual use can vary by community.
